title: Write docs/claude-sub-operator.md and link it from README
description: Write docs/claude-sub-operator.md for the operator, plain prose, short: (1) make a token: claude setup-token on the subscription's account; (2) add: cd cloudflare && pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLAUDE_SUB_TOKEN_<LABEL> (production config, no -c), label rules from the LABEL regex in cloudflare/src/claude-sub.ts; list: wrangler secret list (names only); rotate: put again; remove: wrangler secret delete; nothing to redeploy, the pool reads secret names at each lease; (3) failover: read ClaudeSubPoolCore.lease, classifyAnswer and claudeSubLeaseForBoot and describe exactly what they do (sticky per attempt job id, cap per subscription, bench on a unified quota rejection until reset, the retry is a new job and leases again, step-down to Workers AI when none is free) — say plainly that a running job never switches subscription; (4) select per epic: the config:claude label, --config claude, the [configs] default, from internal/reconcile/runconfig_select.go and .tick/runners.cloud.toml; (5) observe: whatever route/command shows the pool (find it in cloudflare/src/index.ts; describe without any URL or account id — the repo is public). Add one line linking it from README.md where the factory/cloud docs are. Never paste a token, account id or the factory URL.
acceptance_criteria: Every statement is checked against the cited source; README links the doc; make gate passes
